name: onejudge-shell-test-support
//: The helpers every shell suite sources (`helpers.bash`: doubles on PATH, scratch repositories, symlinked scripts). Its own project because two suites in two projects load it — the workspace's offline suite (tests/) and onejudge-scripts-e2e's — and each names it in implicitDependencies, so a change to it reruns both. It has no test of its own: what it does is exercised by every test that loads it.
